cues: Here is his trick, with one to ten.
Write the numbers forwards, then backwards underneath.
Ten columns of eleven is a hundred and ten, but that is the sum twice.
So the sum is fifty five.
text: Here is his trick, with one to ten. Write the numbers forwards, then backwards underneath. Every column adds to eleven. Ten columns of eleven is a hundred and ten, but that is the sum twice. So the sum is fifty five.
